perksWithImages.name: Hex: Haunted Ground
perksWithImages.description:
When the trial starts, 2 Dull Totems ignite.

When either of those Hex Totems is blessed or cleansed:
  • All Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K13P02.ExposedDuration}s.
  • The other Totem is extinguished.

perksWithImages.name: Road Life
perksWithImages.description:
While injured and repairing a Generator:
  • Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S49P01.TokenPerSkillCheck} Token.
  • Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose {Tunable.S49P01.TokensLostOnSkillCheckFail} token.


    • When you have {Tunable.S49P01.MaxTokens} Tokens, you can heal yourself. Spend all Tokens to heal yourself {Tunable.S49P01.HealingSpeedIncrease%}% faster. When you stop healing, this ends after {Tunable.S49P01.HealingLinger}s.

perksWithImages.name: Technician
perksWithImages.description:
While repairing a Generator:
  • The range of Generator repair noises is {Tunable.S09P01.RepairNoiseDistanceReduction}m shorter.
  • Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, the Generator does not explode, but loses {Tunable.S09P01.ExtraProgressLost%}% more progress.

perksWithImages.name: Zanshin Tactics
perksWithImages.description:
Within {Tunable.K18P01.VaultablesRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of Pallets and windows.

Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K18P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
